prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Baytown, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1403; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the rear-end collision you were involved in in Baytown, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you describe where you were when the accident happened?

A: I was stopped at a red light on the main road, waiting to turn left. I had been there for maybe thirty seconds when I felt a hard impact from behind.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: No. I was looking forward at the light. I didn't see it until it hit me.

Q: How fast do you estimate the other vehicle was moving?

A: I really can't say. It sounded like it was going fast, but I didn't see it coming.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. I hit my head on the steering wheel and the side window. I had a headache right away and felt dizzy. They took me to the hospital, and the doctor said I had a concussion.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes, the headaches are still there most days. I get tired faster than usual, and bright lights bother my eyes. I've also had trouble concentrating at work.

Q: Have you seen a doctor since the hospital visit?

A: Yes, I have a follow-up appointment with my primary care doctor, and I've been referred to a neurologist.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?

A: Only that I was not using my phone or doing anything distracting. I was just sitting at the light.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add or correct in your statement?

A: No, that covers it. Thank you.
